# Local compression dependency

Vendored JavaScript + WebAssembly from the npm package `@bokuweb/zstd-wasm` **0.0.27**, authored by bokuweb, declared license MIT in its package metadata. Upstream project: https://github.com/bokuweb/zstd-wasm . Only import specifiers were adjusted to include `.js`, and source-map references were removed to work as native browser ES modules without a bundler. The WebAssembly binary is unmodified and includes libzstd.
